4.heading: unto:
refs: As this promise refers to a return from a captivity among all nations, consequently it cannot be exclusively the Babylonish captivity which is intended

and the repossession of their land must be different from that which was consequent on their return from Babylon. Nor at that period could it be said that they were multiplied more than their fathers, or, as the Hebrew imports, made greater than their fathers, when after their return they were tributary to the Persians, and afterwards fell under the power of the Greeks, under whom they suffered much
nor have their hearts, as a nation, yet been circumcised.

11.heading: it is not hidden:
refs: Or as the word niphlaith implies, not too wonderful for thee to comprehend or perform
but easily to be acquainted with, and understood, because clearly revealed: neither is it afar off
it was proclaimed in you ears from mount Sinai, and is now proclaimed in the sanctuary: it is not in heaven
for it has been already revealed: neither is it beyond the sea
that you need travel for instruction, as the ancient philosophers did, or seek instruction from men, at immense labour and expense
but the word is very nigh to thee
in thy mouth, and in thy heart
made so familiar as to afford a topic of common discourse, that it might be laid up in the memory and reduced to practice. Psa 147:19-20
11.body:
Or as the word niphlaith implies, not too wonderful for thee to comprehend or perform; but easily to be acquainted with, and understood, because clearly revealed: neither is it afar off; it was proclaimed in you ears from mount Sinai, and is now proclaimed in the sanctuary: it is not in heaven; for it has been already revealed: neither is it beyond the sea; that you need travel for instruction, as the ancient philosophers did, or seek instruction from men, at immense labour and expense; but the word is very nigh to thee; brought to thy very doors; in thy mouth, and in thy heart; made so familiar as to afford a topic of common discourse, that it might be laid up in the memory and reduced to practice.
